pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-brown patches with predominantly linear edges and moderately sharp vertices. Geometries consist of irregular quadrilaterals and pentagons. Patch area is smallest on the upper neck and increases significantly in scale toward the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous lattice of light-cream interstitial pathways. Junctions are characterized by tri-point and quad-point nodes. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform, creating a defined grid-like separation between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the cervical ridge presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette. Individual hair tufts create a dense, serrated edge with consistent height across the visible upper neck.
